article_online_scams.summary: Scam messages are built on a small number of patterns, and those patterns leave signals you can learn to read in seconds. After reading this you can recognise the four structures behind almost every scam, spot the tells in a message before you act, run the first-ten-minutes procedure after an incident, choose payment methods that can be reversed, and say the sentences that stop a scammer without alarming the people around you.
article_online_scams.title: How to Spot Online Scams and Fake Messages

article_trip_to_the_moon.summary: A girl climbs into a rocket and flies all the way to the Moon. Follow her through the countdown, the long dark sky and the quiet grey surface. After reading, you can retell the trip, use five new space words in your own sentences, and explain why the Moon feels light and bouncy.
article_trip_to_the_moon.title: A Trip to the Moon
